sources.title: Third-party M77 export and converter in joyboseroy/indus_decipher
sources.access: Public repository metadata, LICENSE, converter and CSV fetched; only the 12 pilot rows inspected after primary-source transcription checkpoint. No broad tabulation performed.
sources.provenance_claim: Converter author says the input was exported from IndusScript.in through a logged-in browser. We did not obtain the raw export or independently audit that extraction.
sources.independent_check: All 12 pilot base-sign sequences agree with our primary-source normalization. Main faces 4581.20 and 4591.20 have 25.0 mean_uncertainty; this does not locate the doubtful sign.
limitations: Converter discards exact positions of starred signs in the CSV.
R-L is a default meaning as-stored, not an audited direction.
damaged=False is a converter default, not proof of an undamaged object.
Zero/000 is not an ordinary M77 sign; an illegible span can cover one or more signs.
No validation here of full-corpus counts or its claim to match a published analytical corpus.
sources.reuse_license: Repository LICENSE is MIT (2026 Joy Bose). Rights to the underlying third-party portal export are not established by that software license; no raw corpus is redistributed.
